capabilities: Sync a vault with a GitLab project branch over the REST API on desktop and mobile
Auto-merge text files and preserve both sides of conflicts as separate files
Trigger syncs on startup, edits, a timer, and mobile foreground/background events
Store the GitLab access token in Obsidian SecretStorage and redact it from logs
Seed an empty GitLab repository with an initial commit from the vault
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; licensed AGPL-3.0-only; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer; the README documents security caveats such as the self-signed certificate toggle and warns to back up the vault before connecting.
intentEvidence: an independently maintained GitLab rewrite, based on GitHub Gitless Sync by Silvano Cerza
motivation: The author built it for mobile devices where Git is unavailable, while keeping the repository usable with ordinary git pull/git push from desktop collaborators.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to keep a vault synced with a GitLab repository on devices, such as iOS and Android, where Git cannot be installed.

summary: Vault-to-GitLab sync over the GitLab REST API with no local Git, aimed at mobile devices while staying compatible with desktop Git workflows.
